    Sign functions for string algebras #

    Butler–Ringel sign functions σ, ε : Q₁ → Bool: arrows with a common source have different σ, arrows with a common target have different ε, and σ b ≠ ε a whenever ab is a nonzero path. They exist for special biserial path data (exists_signs).

    A letter starts with sign S and ends with sign E; in a string consecutive letters l, l' satisfy S l' ≠ E l.

    Sign functions on the arrows.

    • σ : D.Q.A → Bool
    • ε : D.Q.A → Bool
    • hσ (a b : D.Q.A) : a ≠ b → D.Q.src a = D.Q.src b → self.σ a ≠ self.σ b
    • hε (a b : D.Q.A) : a ≠ b → D.Q.tgt a = D.Q.tgt b → self.ε a ≠ self.ε b
    • hall (a b : D.Q.A) : D.toPathData.Allowed a b → self.σ b ≠ self.ε a
